critical.title: ElevenLabs Webhook Accepts Unauthenticated Tool Calls
critical.detail: Path 3 auth grants full access (create/cancel reservations, customer lookup) if request includes any restaurant_id + valid action in query params. No signature, no secret. Restaurant UUIDs discoverable via public endpoints.
critical.fix: Remove Path 3 entirely. ElevenLabs tool calls should use HMAC signature (Path 1) or Bearer token (Path 2).

critical.title: Cross-Tenant Customer Data Leak in get_customer_info
critical.detail: get_customer_info searches reservations with supabaseAdmin WITHOUT filtering by restaurant_id. Combined with CRIT-01, any unauthenticated caller can look up any customer's reservation history across all restaurants by phone number.

critical.title: Twilio Voice Signature Check Bypassed
critical.detail: Signature validation runs but on failure logs a warning and continues executing. Attacker can POST crafted payloads to trigger calls on behalf of any restaurant, causing ElevenLabs charges.
critical.fix: Return res.status(403) on signature mismatch instead of continuing.

critical.title: N+1 Query in Customer DNA Profile Listing
critical.detail: listCustomerProfiles executes individual DB query per profile for customer name lookup. 20 profiles = 20 sequential queries.
critical.fix: Batch-fetch customer names in single .in() query, merge in memory.

critical.title: Duplicate Database Layer - Partially Migrated
critical.detail: 6 legacy db-*.js files (~2,215 lines) coexist with 6 new db/*.js files (~2,087 lines). Two production endpoints still import from legacy. New db/clients.js imports withRetry from old db-clients.js.
critical.fix: Delete legacy files, move withRetry into db/clients.js, update 2 production imports + test imports.

critical.title: Dual ElevenLabs Agent Creation Logic
critical.detail: Both independently call ElevenLabs API to create agents. Any API change must be updated in two places.
critical.fix: Make elevenlabs-agent-create.js a thin HTTP handler delegating to elevenlabsAgentService.createAgent().

high.title: In-Memory Rate Limiters Don't Work on Serverless
high.fix: Move to shared Redis-backed store using checkAndApplyRateLimit.

high.title: Vite 3x HIGH CVEs (Dev Server Path Traversal/File Read)
flatted Prototype Pollution + path-to-regexp ReDoS
high.fix: npm audit fix in root and client

high.title: proactive-comms.js Queries Wrong Schema - Completely Broken
high.detail: Queries .from('customer_ltv') (defaults to public schema) but table lives in restaurant schema. Returns zero results silently. At-risk customer detection is non-functional.
high.fix: Add .schema('restaurant') to the query. Update stale comment.

high.title: update-churn-scores.js Unbounded Reservation Fetch
high.detail: Fetches ALL completed reservations per restaurant with no .limit(). Sequential N+1 upsert per customer. Will timeout at scale.

high.title: generate-reflections.js Unbounded Observation Fetch
high.fix: Add .limit() and process in batches with time-budget guard.

high.title: manager-briefings.js No Timeout Guard for Sequential LLM Calls
high.detail: Each restaurant gets LLM call (10-30s) + WhatsApp + chart. With 3+ restaurants, exceeds 60s limit.
high.fix: Add Promise.race timeout guard per restaurant. Cap at 2 restaurants per invocation.

high.title: Missing Env Vars from .env.example
high.detail: OPENROUTER_API_KEY (primary AI provider), POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID, HEALTH_ALERT_PHONE
high.fix: Add to .env.example and add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to validate-env.js critical list.

high.title: Inconsistent Error Response Format (50/50 Split)
high.detail: Pattern A: { error: 'message' } (~335 uses) vs Pattern B: { success: false, error: 'message' } (~382 uses).

high.title: Auth + Cron Boilerplate Duplicated in 46+ Endpoints
high.detail: 30+ endpoints manually inline verifyAuth. 16+ crons inline CRON_SECRET check. authMiddleware() exists but zero production endpoints use it.
high.fix: Extract verifyCron(req, res) and promote authMiddleware usage.

high.title: ElevenLabs Webhook (742 lines) Has Zero Tests
high.fix: Write integration tests covering auth paths, tool dispatch, cross-tenant isolation.

high.title: 13 of 19 Cron Jobs Lack Dedicated Tests
high.fix: Prioritize tests for crons with business logic (update-churn-scores, generate-reflections, proactive-comms, send-campaigns).
